name: cf-cdn-per-domain-processor
description: Processes a single domain's full Cloudflare CDN configuration into an intermediate representation (IR) accumulator YAML file. Reads the domain entry from domain_scope.json and all 11 Cloudflare rule types (Redirect, URL Rewrite, Configuration, Origin, Bulk Redirect, Request Header Transform, Cache, Cloud Connector, Custom Error, Response Header Transform, Compression) to produce CloudFront-native IR with cache behaviors, origin settings, policy configurations, and viewer request/response operation lists. Outputs ir/accumulator/{hostname}.yaml. Must be invoked once per domain (parallelizable).
